name: @go4/marketing-page
description: Self-contained renderer for go4 landing pages. Framework-agnostic React, own scoped styles, zero design-system dependency. Shared by the admin app, the B2B portal and the public brand page.

scripts.build: npm run clean && node scripts/css.mjs --write-dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --packages=external --jsx=automatic --banner:js='"use client";' && esbuild src/data.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/data.js --packages=external && esbuild src/file.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/file.js --packages=external --jsx=automatic && node scripts/check-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
